name: ESO 490-017 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 490-017, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso490017-hubble
story: So faint across its face, this dwarf irregular galaxy appears as a faint, starry swarm behind brighter foreground stars. Hubble observed it in a program studying how galaxies move through space.

claims.text: ESO 490-017 is a dwarf irregular galaxy
Its low surface brightness makes it appear as a faint, starry swarm behind brighter foreground stars
The data came from a Hubble program on the movement of galaxies
